2607.11307.title: Efficient Test-Time Optimization for Multi-Agent Proof Autoformalization
2607.11307.paper_summary: Full-proof autoformalization bridges extensive mathematical proofs in natural language with formally validated reasoning, offering a pathway to elevate the ceiling of verifiable mathematical reasoning. Unlike statement-level formalization, proof autoformalization is a long-horizon challenge requiring coordination of claims, contexts, and dependencies across many proof steps, yet has only recently come under focused study. Current approaches either rely on costly model training or apply excessive, unguided repair at inference time. To this end, we introduce ToMap, a multi-agent framework that structures proof autoformalization as a Decomposer-Formalizer-Prover pipeline with efficient test-time optimization guided by formal verification and semantic rubrics for proof quality. Rather than distributing test-time compute across all agents, we perform bottleneck analysis and identify the Decomposer as the critical bottleneck: the quality of its atomic, self-contained proof units directly determines whether downstream agents can successfully formalize and prove each step. ToMap therefore treats the Formalizer and Prover as downstream executors and efficiently focuses test-time compute on Decomposer refinement. This refinement follows a loop inspired by GEPA, evolving prompts over candidate decompositions and using formal verification progress together with semantic proof rubrics to define a Pareto frontier that guides the next decomposition update. Experiments on ProofFlowBench show that ToMap improves over the best previous method by 19.0% when evaluated by both syntactic correctness and semantic faithfulness, while requiring lower test-time cost. Scaling analysis shows that most gains emerge within a few iterations of decomposition evolution, guiding test-time budget selection.
2607.11307.paper_summary_zh: 全自動形式化橋接了自然語言中的廣泛數學證明與正式驗證的推理，提供了一條提升可驗證數學推理上限的途徑。與聲明層級的形式化不同，證明自動形式化是一個長期挑戰，需要協調多個證明步驟中的主張、上下文和依賴關係，但直到最近才受到專注研究。目前的方法要麼依賴昂貴的模型訓練，要麼在推理時進行過度的、無指導的修正。為此，我們介紹了ToMap，一個多代理框架，將證明自動形式化結構化為一個分解器-形式化器-證明者的管道，並通過正式驗證和語義標準對證明質量進行有效的測試時間優化。我們不會將測試時間的計算分配給所有代理，而是進行瓶頸分析，並確定分解器是關鍵瓶頸：其原子、自包含的證明單元的質量直接決定了下游代理是否能成功形式化和證明每一步。因此，ToMap將形式化器和證明者視為下游執行者，並有效地將測試時間的計算集中在分解器的改進上。這一改進遵循一個受GEPA啟發的循環，圍繞候選分解進化提示，並利用正式驗證進展和語義證明標準來定義一個Pareto邊界，以指導下一次分解更新。在ProofFlowBench上的實驗顯示，ToMap在語法正確性和語義忠實性兩方面的評估中，比之前最佳方法提高了19.0%，同時要求較低的測試時間成本。擴展分析顯示，大多數增益在幾次分解演變中出現，指導測試時間預算的選擇。
